data.etymology: Adaloon belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Just.”

in_arabic.name: عدلون
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من العدالة، يعني العادل والمتعادل
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم 'عدلون' مشتق من جذر 'ع-د-ل' الذي يعني العدالة والتوازن. في اللغة العربية، يُستخدم هذا الاسم للإشارة إلى الشخص الذي يتميز بالعدالة والإنصاف. له أهمية كبيرة في الثقافة الإسلامية حيث يُعتبر العدل من أهم القيم الأخلاقية.

in_urdu.name: عدلون
in_urdu.meaning: عدالت سے متعلق، عادل اور منصف
in_urdu.long_meaning: نام 'عدلون' عربی جڑ 'ع-د-ل' سے ماخوذ ہے جو کہ عدالت اور توازن کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔ اردو میں، یہ نام ان شخصیتوں کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو عدالت اور انصاف کی نمائندگی کرتے ہیں۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلم روایت میں اس کا خاصا اہمیت ہے جہاں عدل کو ایک اعلیٰ اخلاقی قدر کے طور پر دیکھا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अदलून
in_hindi.meaning: न्याय से संबंधित, न्यायी और निष्पक्ष
in_hindi.long_meaning: नाम 'अदलून' अरबी जड़ 'ع-د-ل' से लिया गया है, जो न्याय और संतुलन को दर्शाता है। देवanagari में, यह नाम उन व्यक्तित्वों के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है जो न्याय और निष्पक्षता का प्रतिनिधित्व करते हैं। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में इसका विशेष महत्व है जहां न्याय को एक उच्च नैतिक मूल्य के रूप में देखा जाता है।

in_pashto.name: عدلون
in_pashto.meaning: د عدالت څخه مشتق شوی، عادل او منصف
in_pashto.long_meaning: د 'عدلون' نوم د عربی جڑ 'ع-د-ل' څخه اخیستل شوی دی، کوم چې د عدالت او توازن معنی ورکوي. په پښتو کې، دا نوم د هغو کسانو لپاره کارول کیږي چې د عدالت او انصاف استازیتوب کوي. د افغان او پښتن تراد کې دا نوم ډیره اهميت لري چیرته چې عدل د یو لوړ اخلاقي ارزښت په توګه لیدل کیږي.

in_english.name: Adaloon
in_english.meaning: Derived from justice, means just and fair
in_english.long_meaning: The name Adaloon is derived from the Arabic root 'ع-د-ل' (al-'adl), which signifies justice, balance, and fairness. In Islamic tradition, 'adl (justice) is considered one of the most essential moral values. Historically, this name has been used to denote individuals known for their just and equitable nature. The name Adaloon holds spiritual significance as it reflects the attributes of fairness and righteousness, highly valued in Muslim cultures worldwide.

pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ تفصیل: عدلون

data.cultural_impact: The Islamic name "Adaloon" carries cultural significance as it is derived from the Arabic root "xdl", meaning "to be just", "to be upright", or "to be fair". In Islamic tradition, the essence of a good character is often rooted in qualities of justice and fairness. Thus, the name "Adaloon" is a powerful reminder of the cultural and moral values that have shaped Islamic societies.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the Islamic name "Adaloon" lies in its connection to the divine attribute of Adl or "justice" and "righteousness". In Islamic theology, Allah (God) is described as the most Just and Fair, and He is the Mondemmad (the awise arbiter) who bestows mercy and justice upon all His creation. By naming a child "Adaloon", parents are reminding themselves and their child of the divine attributes they should strive to embody. The name serves as a reminder of the importance of seeking Allah's pleasure by living a just and righteous life, and as a source of inspiration for the child to grow up striving for fairness, justice, and righteousness in every aspect of their life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Adaloon: Just and Righteous. A name that signifies a person who upholds truth and justice in all their actions and interactions. It is a reminder to strive for balance and fairness in one's personal and communal life.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: The name Adaloon is derived from the Arabic word 'adl', meaning 'justice'. It was used as the name for a legal reform movement that emerged in Egypt in the late 19th and early 20th centuries. The movement sought to challenge the Ottoman rule and establish a modern legal system based on Islamic principles.

Another reference to the name Adaloon can be found in the context of the Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant (ISIL, also known as ISIS). ISIL has used the name 'Adl I Bilma' or 'Adl Billah' (Justice of God) as a part of its propaganda to justify its violent actions and claim a religious mandate for its rule. This usage of the term is a departure from the original meaning of 'justice' as a legal reform movement.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Adaloon' is rooted in Islamic spirituality and is often associated with the Sufi tradition. In modern contexts, this name can be seen on various platforms. On social media, there are numerous groups and pages dedicated to the Sufi path and the teachings of Adaloon. In educational institutions, there are courses and programs focused on the study of Sufism and Islamic spirituality, which may include the name Adaloon. Finally, at spiritual retreats and centers, the name Adaloon is used to signify a place of learning and introspection for those seeking a deeper connection to their faith and spirituality.
